airflow_sub_auto: Following printer activity and bed temperature automatically.
airflow_sub_closed: Held closed manually. The printer will not change it.
airflow_sub_open: Held open manually. The printer will not change it.
cal_bad: At least one endstop is off. Check that the vent moves freely and that the sensor cable is seated.
cam_rtsp_off: RTSP is turned off on the printer. Turn it on from the printer's own screen, under the camera settings, and the address will appear here.
dlg_ap_text: The hotspot uses the new name and password from its next start.
dlg_bind_code_text: The printer rejected the access code. Check it on the printer under Settings, Network.
dlg_bind_ip_text: The vent could not reach the printer at that address. Check the IP address and that both are on the same network.
dlg_bind_ok_text: The vent is talking to the printer. The Status page fills in as the printer reports.
dlg_bind_sn_text: The printer did not accept that serial number. Copy it from the printer's own settings screen.
dlg_bind_unknown_text: The printer did not answer in a way the vent understands. Check the details and try again.
dlg_conn_ok_text: The vent joined the Wi-Fi network. Next, bind your printer.
dlg_conn_pw_text: The network refused the password. Check it and connect again.
dlg_conn_reconnect_text: The vent lost the network and is trying again.
dlg_error_text: The vent refused the request. Nothing was changed.
dlg_factory_text: The vent erases its settings and restarts. Connect to its hotspot to set it up again.
dlg_hostname_text: The vent restarts to take the new name.
dlg_hotspot_ip_text: The vent restarts to move to the new address.
dlg_ota_err_text: The vent did not accept the image. The running firmware is unchanged.
dlg_ota_text: The vent restarts into the new firmware. This page reloads when it is back.
dlg_ota_unknown_text: The vent did not recognise the upload type. Nothing was changed.
dlg_scan_ip_text: The printer answered from the address the vent already has. If the vent cannot reach it, check the hotspot settings.
dlg_scan_newip_text: The printer moved and the vent now uses its new address.
dlg_scan_ok_text: Pick a printer from the list, then bind it.
dlg_scan_sn_text: No printer on the network reported that serial number.
preview_running: Previewing on the strip. Nothing is saved. Ends in %ss.
status_logs_label: The last lines the device wrote to itself
ui_a_factory_reset_erases_the_wi_fi_c: A factory reset erases the Wi-Fi credentials, the printer binding and every light setting. It cannot be undone from here.
ui_a_name_is_easier_to_remember_than_: A name is easier to remember than an address and survives the router handing out a different one.
ui_adding_local_to_this_name_reaches_: Adding .local to this name reaches the vent from any device on the network.
ui_address_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.
ui_ap_note_on: Always on, so you can always reach the vent. Changing the name, the password or this switch drops you if you are connected through it.
ui_cam_rtsp_disabled: RTSP is switched off on the printer. Turn on LAN Mode Liveview in the printer's camera settings, then the address appears here.
ui_cam_rtsp_enabled: A browser cannot play this stream. Copy the address into VLC or Home Assistant.
ui_connect_to_this_from_a_phone_or_la: Connect to this from a phone or laptop when the vent is not on your Wi-Fi, then open the address below.
ui_cycle_the_vent_auto_open_closed: Cycle the vent: auto, open, closed
ui_dark_whenever_the_vent_is_closed_f: Dark whenever the vent is closed, factory behaviour when open
ui_do_not_close_a_chamber_that_is_sti: Do not close a chamber that is still hot from the last print
ui_drives_the_flap_onto_both_stops_an: Drives the flap onto both stops and reports what the hall sensor read at each one. Nothing is stored; this answers "is the sensor seeing the magnet".
ui_each_row_of_the_image_becomes_one_: Each row of the image becomes one frame across the strip. Held in memory, so it is gone after a restart.
ui_endstop_check_already_running: An endstop check is already running.
ui_endstop_check_confirm_text: The vent will close, then open, then go back to where it was, and the hall reading at each end is reported. It takes about ten seconds.
ui_factory_behaviour_dark_in_auto_bli: Factory behaviour: dark in Auto, blinking in manual
ui_fill_in_the_serial_number_access_c: Fill in the serial number, access code and IP address first.
ui_how_many_leds_each_strip_really_ha: How many LEDs each strip really has. Effects with a centre, and the progress bar, need these to land in the right place.
ui_leave_this_alone_unless_it_clashes: Leave this alone unless it clashes with something on your network.
ui_leds_count_range: Each strip takes between 1 and 16 LEDs.
ui_lit_whenever_the_vent_is_open_fact: Lit whenever the vent is open, factory behaviour when closed
ui_note_policy_heat_text: After a print the flap is held open until the bed reads cool. It stays open above one temperature and may close below a lower one, so the flap does not chatter as the bed drifts across a single threshold.
ui_note_policy_materials_text: All nine rules ship on. Switch one off and that material gets no rule and falls back to the factory behaviour. The loaded filament is whatever the printer reports; one with no matching rule is left alone.
ui_note_policy_text: With this on, the vent reads the filament the printer says is loaded: a venting material opens the flap, a sealing material closes it, and a material with no rule gets the factory behaviour. With it off, venting is exactly what the factory firmware does.
ui_note_ring_blink_text: The factory firmware blinks the button ring while the vent is in manual. This switch keeps or drops that blink on its own, so you can have the factory behaviour without the blinking.
ui_pctl_needs_dev_mode: The printer refused: it only takes this from a signed app unless Developer Mode (LAN mode) is on.
ui_pick_a_colour_for_the_strip_you_ca: Pick a colour for the strip. You can change all of this later, in much more detail, on the Lighting page.
ui_policy_temps_bad_number: Enter a whole number in both temperature fields.
ui_policy_temps_bad_order: The close-below temperature must be lower than the hold-open-above temperature.
ui_put_the_vent_on_the_same_network_a: Put the vent on the same network as the printer.
ui_records_each_print_to_the_printer_: Records each print to the printer's own card
ui_reverse_every_effect_on_both_strip: Reverse every effect on both strips
ui_seal_or_vent_depending_on_what_is_: Seal or vent depending on what is loaded
ui_settings_could_not_be_saved_the_de: Settings could not be saved. The device will forget them on restart.
ui_show_a_different_effect_for_each_p: Show a different effect for each printer state
ui_show_the_warning_colours_above_the: Show the warning colours above the hot threshold
ui_simple_uses_one_effect_all_the_tim: Simple uses one effect all the time. Per printer state gives each of the six states its own. Hot chamber has two: safe, and over the threshold.
ui_the_factory_firmware_opens_the_ven: The factory firmware opens the vent during every print. ABS and its relatives want the chamber sealed, and the printer says which filament is loaded, so the vent can decide for itself.
ui_the_factory_setting_is_a_steady_re: The factory setting is a steady red
ui_the_master_switch_for_both_strips: The master switch for both strips
ui_the_name_shown_in_the_bar_above_an: The name shown in the bar above and on your network.
ui_the_page_you_are_looking_at: The page you are looking at
ui_the_printer_is_refusing_commands_t: The printer is refusing commands. Turn on Developer Mode, under LAN Only Mode, on the printer's own screen.
ui_the_vent_clears_the_stored_binding: The vent clears the stored binding and stops talking to the printer. You can bind it again from this page.
ui_the_vent_finds_bambu_printers_on_t: The vent finds Bambu printers on the same network. Pick yours and it fills in the serial; the access code is on the printer's own screen.
ui_the_vent_talks_to_the_printer_dire: The vent talks to the printer directly over your own network; nothing goes through Bambu's cloud. Scan finds Bambu printers on the network and fills in the serial number; the LAN access code is on the printer under Settings, Network, LAN Only Mode, and it changes if LAN Only Mode is turned off and on again.
ui_these_write_to_the_printer_so_they: These write to the printer, so they need Developer Mode switched on under LAN Only Mode. Everything above only listens.
ui_this_printer_has_no_camera_or_has_: This printer has no camera, or has not reported one.
ui_treat_both_as_one_long_run_so_effe: Treat both as one long run, so effects sweep end to end
ui_type_this_address_into_a_browser_o: Type this address into a browser on any device on the same network to open this page again.
ui_upload_sent: Sent. Waiting for the device to check it
ui_use_the_open_or_closed_colour_depe: Use the open or closed colour depending on the flap
ui_warn_hot_range: The warning temperature must be between %s and %s °C.
ui_warn_hot_reset_done: Warning temperature back to the default.
waiting_for_device: Waiting for the device. These controls are showing placeholders until it answers, so they are inactive for a moment.
warn_hot_note: The factory firmware calls 50 °C hot and cannot be told otherwise. That suits PLA and not ABS, where the bed sits at a hundred all print.
